title: Codex model catalog observation provenance@1
$comment: Credential-free provenance for a captured token-free harness catalog projection. The coordinator records advertised IDs and efforts. Inference access requires separate evidence. In crates/af/tests/fixtures/provider-models/, reproduce the preserved 20261107 projection from codex-provider-models-raw-20261107.json by retaining gpt-6.1-sol and gpt-6.1-terra. Reproduce the current 20261123 projection from codex-provider-models-raw-20261123.json by retaining gpt-6.2-sol and gpt-6.2-astra. In each case, filter only providers[0].models, preserving the selected model objects, their order and every other field. The provenance fields raw_response_sha256 and recorded_projection_sha256 identify the exact bytes of the raw file and the matching codex-provider-models-recorded-YYYYMMDD.json, respectively. Other raw model entries are observational data only.
